title: Create worktree mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from new-worktree's mod.json, and the settings it takes.

title.description: The mod's name, as Herdr shows it.

place.description: Where Herdr first docks the mod.

issue_branch.title: Issue branch
issue_branch.description: Branch name for a worktree started from an issue. {number} and {slug} (the title) are filled in. A project's own setting wins.

issue_prompt.title: Issue prompt
issue_prompt.description: Pasted into Claude (not sent) for a worktree started from an issue. {number}, {title}, {repo} and {branch} are filled in. Blank keeps this default; a project's own setting wins.
issue_prompt.default: Work on GitHub issue #{number} in {repo}: "{title}". Read it first with: gh issue view {number} -R {repo} --comments

pr_prompt.title: PR prompt
pr_prompt.description: Pasted into Claude (not sent) for a worktree started from a pull request. {number}, {title}, {repo} and {branch} are filled in. Blank keeps this default; a project's own setting wins.
pr_prompt.default: Pick up GitHub pull request #{number} in {repo}: "{title}". Read it first with: gh pr view {number} -R {repo} --comments
